headline: Vidhiśāstras acts for Pagani Capital on $35 mn India-focused residency investment programme
sum: Vidhiśāstras structured a $35 mn India/Middle-East residency investment programme giving Indian investors access to Portugal projects.
detail: Vidhiśāstras – Advocates & Solicitors advised Pagani Capital Holding on the structuring, regulatory framework and promotion of a $35 million India and Middle-East focused residency investment programme, facilitating foreign capital participation in qualifying projects. The mandate covered foreign-investment considerations, corporate structuring, compliance, investor onboarding, transaction documentation and cross-border legal due diligence.

firms.name: Vidhiśāstras
firms.note: Firm-led mandate; individual team members not named in the announcement.
